about: The computer's own places (every folder, sqlite store, notes store and recordings folder a row of computer-sources.json describes), the two carried conversations (iMessage, WhatsApp) and Mac Contacts move from Trillion-X/trillion's computer/ into one Workshop tool,. Every connected service's descriptors with the connect, rename, disconnect and grant code (parts/service-connections) were moved by the whole-tree move a9ee258 (Trillion-X/trillion 5cd0dc3) into tools/connect-a-service-and-seal-its-key, so this row no longer holds that group; that folder's tool:list-every-connection reads its service rows and this tool's place rows into the one Connections list. Byte for byte: the next commits adapt them. The helper's main loop (computer/read-this-computer.mjs), always-on listening (computer/listen.mjs, another lane) and every other computer/ file stay and import what moved from the trillion-workshop package.
